integrity_notes: Analytical proof supplied; reproducibility tests are finite diagnostics, not independent verification. The explicit asymptotic construction proves the coefficient, not an exact finite-size optimizer.
limitations: Finite unweighted rooted trees; vertex-counting descendant means; edge total variation. The finite-N extremal maximum is not explicitly classified beyond its linear asymptotic.
title: Descendant averaging on rooted trees: exact variation norm and the sharp asymptotic coefficient
